scientific.integrity: The accepted result is proved by scalar comparison and an explicit predator decay estimate. A numerical replay only stress-tests a parameter point that violates the discarded source condition; no independent audit has been performed.
scientific.limitations: A sufficient extinction/global-stability criterion for the autonomous source model; it is not necessary, excludes prey-boundary initial data from convergence to the all-ones equilibrium, and does not cover delayed, stochastic, or modified food-web systems.

title: A redundant predation-strength condition in a multi-prey Holling-II extinction theorem
